should_trigger: Write a polite follow-up email after no response.
Help me reply to this client complaint.
Make this email shorter and more professional.
Draft a message declining a meeting request.
I need a cold outreach email with a clear ask.
should_not_trigger: Write a blog post announcing our product.
Create landing-page copy for this offer.
Summarize this email thread into meeting notes.
Draft a formal project proposal for leadership.

tasks.prompt: Draft a follow-up to a hiring manager seven days after an interview, warm but not pushy.
criteria: Uses a concise subject and context

tasks.prompt: Reply to a customer whose delivery is late when the new delivery date is not yet confirmed.
criteria: Provides a concrete next update commitment

tasks.prompt: Decline a vendor demo while preserving the relationship for next quarter.
criteria: Sets an honest future condition without false promises
